Class PublicEnquiryController

java.lang.Object
com.crmconnect.connection.PublicEnquiryController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/public/enquiries") public class PublicEnquiryController extends Object
Public company sites create a Lead and trigger confirmation emails. Requires OTP Email Verification.
